title: Oldest Recording of Louisiana’s Vanishing Creole Language Is Published
description: The rediscovery of a forgotten recording from 1935 sheds light on a language rooted in the state’s history of slavery and French colonialism.
author: Leo Sands

title: 2 Helicopters Collide Midair in Oregon, Killing All 3 Aboard
description: A student pilot and a flight instructor were killed, along with the person in the second helicopter, officials said. The cause has not been determined.
author: Francesca Regalado

title: Republicans Ramp Up Investigation Into Democratic Plan to Pack Alaska’s Ballot
description: The Justice Department issued subpoenas, a House oversight committee sought interviews and the state opened its own inquiry into a Democratic plan to recruit a spoiler into a Senate race.
author: Kellen Browning, Anna Griffin and Glenn Thrush

title: A Sailor Jumped From the U.S.S. Lincoln. The Navy Punished Him.
description: The case offers a rare look at the military’s handling of mental health issues during extended deployments.
author: Jan Ransom

title: In Reversal, Former Primary Rival Will Campaign With El-Sayed
description: Representative Haley Stevens of Michigan, who was defeated by Dr. Abdul El-Sayed in August’s Democratic Senate primary, said she would appear with the candidate this weekend.
author: Reid J. Epstein

title: Bostonians Compete to Be Their Airport’s New Voice
description: By Christmas, the winning voice will echo through Boston Logan International in recorded greetings and announcements that millions of travelers will hear.
author: Jenna Russell

title: Here’s the latest.
author: Chris Cameron

title: Trump Cancels Rallies in Kansas and Iowa This Weekend
description: President Trump has been holding hours-long rallies for G.O.P. candidates nearly every day for weeks.
author: Chris Cameron

title: How Common Is Ballot Stacking? What to Know as Conflict Roils Alaska Senate Race.
description: As a conflict over candidates roils the Alaskan Senate race, here’s a look back at the political practice over the years.
author: Madison Malone Kircher

title: Homeland Security Leak Exposes More Than 41,000 Employees
description: A nonprofit said it released the information to promote transparency about the Trump administration’s deportation campaign. Homeland security officials told workers they are reviewing the incident.
author: Madeleine Ngo and Dustin Volz

title: Moody Makes Appeal to a South Florida Audience Leery of the Left
description: Senator Ashley Moody, Republican of Florida, campaigned in Miami-Dade County, an area with a large Cuban population that the G.O.P. is hoping to keep red.
author: Patricia Mazzei

title: Georgia Republican Donor Gets 15 Years in $76 Million Ponzi Scheme
description: Federal prosecutors said Edwin Brant Frost IV lured investors with promises of high returns, but used new money to pay earlier investors and fund personal expenses.
author: Mark Walker

title: Trump Administration Pressures California With Expanded Voter Fraud Investigation
description: The department has issued grand jury subpoenas to local election officials as part of a widening effort to prove unsubstantiated claims about large numbers of illegal voters in the state.
author: Devlin Barrett and Shawn Hubler

title: Oberlin College Professor and His Wife Are Murdered by His Son, Police Say
description: Pipo Nguyen-duy, 64, was the studio art chairman at the liberal arts college in Ohio and had been honored for his photography, including being named a Guggenheim fellow.
author: Neil Vigdor

title: Fallout in Alaska Senate Race Over Peltola’s Ballot Stacking Plot
description: Both sides have a long tradition of promoting spoiler candidates.
author: Jess Bidgood

title: Trump Erupted After Learning of Alina Habba’s $50 Million Deal
description: Angry about the scale of a contract signed by one of his former lawyers with the family of a wealthy pardon seeker, the president told allies he wanted some of the money to go to his future presidential library.
author: Tyler Pager

title: Seeing an opening, a Democratic super PAC decides to spend on the South Carolina Senate race.
author: Emily Davies

title: California’s High-Speed Rail Chief Quits Amid Questions About Spending
description: Ian Choudri, the chief executive of the California High-Speed Rail Authority, stepped down weeks after state investigators questioned the spending of $600,000 by the agency.
author: Orlando Mayorquín

title: Michigan Voters Split on Candidate Solutions to Data Center Proposals
description: In battleground Michigan, residents disagree on which candidate in a marquee House race has the better solution to a data center proposal.
author: John Yoon

title: Hegseth Fires Top Army General He Accused of Leaking Information to Media
description: Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia was fired as part of a broad and highly unusual campaign to find and punish senior military officers who speak to reporters.
author: Greg Jaffe
